scope: Public pages plus owner-authorized signed-in profile, statistics, import/export and account controls; no account mutations or hardware pairing. Individual algorithms and populated solve charts were not exhaustively tested.

catalogue.note: 26 set links in the public catalogue; individual algorithms were not exhaustively tested.

library.note: Shared catalogue/case functions; sampled content, not independent correctness verification.

f2l.note: Case taxonomy, slots, variants and usage controls.

big.note: Inner-slice notation, last edges and centres.

guide.note: Tutorial layout and playback inspected in the built-in browser.

guides.note: Three teaching and three reference guides in the public index.

notation.note: Face, wide, slice and rotation notation.

glossary.note: Searchable terms; links to BLD guide and trainer do not prove access.

trainers.note: Ten algorithm drill families and mode selector.

cross.note: Cross and X-cross settings and playback.

pll.note: Two-sided recognition, weights and confusion feedback.

corners.note: Colour answers, top-colour selection, charts and pair heatmaps inspected.

timer.note: Session and timer dialogs inspected, including 2x2 through 7x7.

stats.note: Personal bests, activity calendar, algorithm progress and import/export inspected; solve history is empty, so populated charts remain unverified.

analyze.note: Public CFOP/Roux entry and example inspected.

smart.note: GAN, MoYu and QiYi, saved-cube list and capability checks inspected. No hardware connection qualified; reference setup instructions are not our compatibility guarantee.

settings.note: Theme and algorithm display preferences inspected.

search.note: Search dialog inspected; sample reconstruction query returned no matches.

changes.note: Historical reports, not proof of current public availability.

credits.note: Source discovery only; each imported artifact requires its own license review.

privacy.note: Reference account/data practices; our own policy must match our implementation.

terms.note: Reference account/legal surface, not legal terms to copy.

owner.note: Requested project scope beyond the public reference.

bld.note: The guide redirects to alpha access even after ordinary sign-in. Course content remains unverified.

speffz.note: The trainer remains restricted to alpha testers after ordinary sign-in; no restricted content accessed.

interface.note: Public browser interface descriptions advertise letter-pair practice; actual UI workflow unverified.

account.note: Profile and account controls inspected read-only. Private profile URL and account values deliberately excluded.

trainingStats.note: Per-set and per-case summaries, skill, success, timing and drill links inspected without changing attempts.
